events.info: FRESH..FUN! Peter Pan! Peter, Wendy, John and Michael will FLY! Steven McMahon's fantastically fresh staging of Peter Pan is the perfect match to the scenic talents of Tony Award-winner Beowulf Boritt, fantastic costumes by award-winning designer Anne Armit, and our gravity-defying cast of dancers, thanks to the highly technical and automated magic of ZFX Flying Effects. Back for the first time in nearly 10 years, this high-flying adventure will leave you breathless, so grab your seat now, before they all fly away.

events.info: Experience a night of breakthrough and freedom on The Witness Tour with Red Worship. The musical expression of Redemption Church in San Jose, California, led by Pastors Ron and Hope Carpenter, Red Worship brings a bold, presence-driven sound built on the conviction that sound precedes movement. Carrying momentum from a year of global growth and millions of lives touched, this tour is designed to break strongholds, lift up the name of Jesus, and unify the body of Christ. Expect an unforgettable evening of vibrant praise, prophetic worship, and authentic encounters with God. VIP Doors - 5:30 PM Early Entry Doors - 6:30 PM General Admission Doors - 6:45 PM Show Starts - 7:30 PM. ***Minglewood Hall is a cashless venue. This event is general admission standing.
